subject: Request: expand PLG trial allowance for Aurora POC (large-context)
messages:
From: Emma Wu <emma.wu@auroraai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auroraai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: PLG trial bump for Aurora POC - large context

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. As promised, I'm following up with a short write-up of our POC needs so you can determine whether we should request an expanded PLG allowance rather than starting on a paid Dedicated lane.

POC summary (2 weeks):
- Use case: multi-document thread reconciliation + long-form context summarization for legal transcripts.
- Context window: ~120k tokens (we'll be feeding concatenated transcripts).
- Average generation length: ~800-1,200 tokens per request.
- Estimated peak TPM: 60-80 (bursty during ingest and nightly processing).
- Projected token consumption for 2-week POC: ~4M - 6M tokens.

Current self-serve trial on our account shows the default credit (small) which won't cover the above. Can Redwood increase the initial PLG credit grant and extend the trial window by 30 days so we can complete the POC? We prefer a self-serve/top-up so we can start immediately; providing a promo code or temporary allowance is ideal.

I've attached the POC spec and a small CSV of our traffic estimate. Happy to hop on a quick call if you need more detail.

Thanks,
Emma Wu
Head of Product
Aurora AI
Attachments: aurora_poc_spec.pdf (pdf), poc_context_metrics.csv (csv)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wu <emma.wu@auroraai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PLG trial bump for Aurora POC - large context

Hi Emma — appreciate the details and the spec. This is the exact kind of POC we want to make seamless.

Quick internal note (looping in Marissa and Rishi to approve the bump): to cover the 2-week POC scope, my back-of-envelope suggests a promotional allowance equivalent to $7,500 (roughly 5M tokens at our PLG rates given large-context execution and expected TPM). If we issue a self-serve promo code with a 30-day expiry we can get Aurora started immediately.

Conditions I propose:
- Grant is for evaluation only (no production traffic).
- Single account use for the POC.
- We'll set a soft alert at 80% consumption and do a mid-POC check-in.

Rishi / Marissa — can you confirm approval and, if OK, issue a promo code with the above limits? I'll send the code to Emma and include onboarding notes (best-practices for caching and batching for large windows).

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PLG trial bump for Aurora POC - large context

Sean — approved with the conditions below. I'm attaching a short internal approval note for record-keeping.

Approval summary:
- Approved promotional credit: $7,500 grant.
- Expiry: 30 days from issuance.
- Usage cap: single-account, evaluation only.
- Monitoring: auto-alerts at 80% and 100% consumption; escalation to Sales Ops if 100% is hit.
- Security/compliance: customer provided SOC2 snippets in Drive (ok for POC).

Issuance details (for customer email):
- Promo code: AURORA-PG-2026-11-23
- Visible credit: $7,500 applied on redemption
- Note: code is single-use and will be revoked if production traffic is detected.

Attachment: approval_note_internal.txt

Rishi Malhotra
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Wu <emma.wu@auroraai.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@auroraai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PLG trial bump for Aurora POC - large context

Hi Emma — great news: we've approved the expanded PLG allowance and pushed a promo code for your POC. Details below.

Grant details:
- Promo code: AURORA-PG-2026-11-23
- Amount: $7,500 credit visible on redemption
- Expiry: 2026-12-23 (30 days)
- Conditions: evaluation-only, single account, no production traffic.

Next steps for your team:
1) Redeem the promo code in your self-serve billing portal (link: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/promos).
2) Follow the onboarding doc with recommended batching and prefix/KV caching for large-context workloads (shared: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/aurora-poc).
3) We'll set an 80% usage alert and check in midway through the POC — I'll schedule a 20-minute sync for Dec 1.

Attachments: aurora_poc_spec.pdf (for posterity), poc_context_metrics.csv

If you hit 100% usage before the POC ends, we'll pause and reach out with options (short-term top-up vs. Dedicated consult). Happy to help with parameter tuning to reduce token spend (e.g., response length limits, chunking).

Thanks — excited to see what Aurora builds with this.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
